upstream.project: Netlib Reference BLAS (Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms)
upstream.source_sha256_status: pending: filled in by tools/verify_upstream.ps1 at build time
upstream.license: Netlib reference BLAS; freely redistributable, credit required, modifications must be renamed and commented

semantics: X := op(TRANS)*A^-1 * X, in place, where op(TRANS)*A = A for UPLO='U', A^T for UPLO='L'.
storage_convention: column_major for A; strided linear for X.

singularity.upstream_behaviour: DTRSV divides by A(i,i) with no check. A zero diagonal entry yields infinities and NaNs, or a memory-safety problem only if LDA is also wrong.
singularity.magr_policy: MAGR scans the diagonal first. If DIAG='N' and every diagonal entry is exactly zero (including negative zero), the call is refused with MAGR_STATUS_SINGULAR and X is left unmodified.
singularity.limitation: A triangular matrix that is singular for some right-hand side while having a nonzero diagonal is not detected. MAGR does not claim otherwise. Callers needing a guarantee must use an explicit factorisation with a pivoting/condition check (see docs/roadmap.md).
singularity.after_the_call: If a division still overflows or produces NaN despite a nonzero diagonal, MAGR does not rewrite the result. The caller inspects it under the call contract's tolerance policy.

preconditions: A is f64, rank 2, column_major, square, strides [8, LDA*8], not readonly.
X is an f64 rank-1 writable view of length N with positive stride.
Declared capacity of A backs LDA*N doubles.
The diagonal is not identically zero when DIAG='N' (checked by MAGR).
postconditions: On OK, X holds the solution of the triangular system to within the routine's documented arithmetic.

aliasing.note: X must not overlap A. DTRSV reads A(i,j) during the solve while X is being overwritten.

numerical_contract.accuracy: Backward stable; growth factor bounded by n for a triangular solve.
numerical_contract.reproducibility_note: Substitution order is fixed by dtrsv.f. Build with -ffp-contract=off for bit-identity.

binary.digest_status: pending: requires an actual compiled object
